note: Pilot stand-in for the compact world calendar the exporter will publish from calendar_status: for every panel of panels.json, the planting and harvest dates of the national series of the same crop family for the panel harvest year, copied from the windows of site/data/<release>/units/<ISO3>.json (season_windows). series_crop and series_season name the national series the dates belong to, which may be the Annual series where the panel is seasonal. local_units counts the subnational units of the panel. No value is computed; see site/README.md.
